statement: Use workspace management infrastructure through shared UI infrastructure (8 operators in bpy.ops.workspace): every member behaves as in Blender 5.3 and is covered by common tests instead of one test per operator.
notes: UI-infrastructure group row. Member operators (8): bpy.ops.workspace.add = Add Workspace; bpy.ops.workspace.append_activate = Append and Activate Workspace; bpy.ops.workspace.delete = Delete Workspace; bpy.ops.workspace.delete_all_others = Delete Other Workspaces; bpy.ops.workspace.duplicate = New Workspace; bpy.ops.workspace.reorder_to_back = Workspace Reorder to Back; bpy.ops.workspace.reorder_to_front = Workspace Reorder to Front; bpy.ops.workspace.scene_pin_toggle = Pin Scene to Workspace
